instruction: Review before running verify_stage_a. Each entry is either (a) an LLM-uncertain merge decision, or (b) a CODE_DEFINITE_DUPLICATE that enriched a BEHAVIORAL statement with inferred fields from an IMPLICIT_TRANSITION. Verify that from_state, to_state, pre_cond, post_cond, and trigger are correct for each kept statement.

entries.warning: REVIEW: enriched N-S054-002 with fields ['from_state'] from D-S054-002 — verify correctness
entries.s1_description: A TCP implementation MUST silently discard an incoming SYN segment that is addressed to a broadcast or multicast address (MUST-57).
entries.s2_description: A TCP implementation MUST silently discard an incoming SYN segment that is addressed to a broadcast or multicast address [(MUST-57)].
entries.s1_trigger: receive SYN addressed to broadcast or multicast

entries.warning: REVIEW: enriched N-S041-007 with fields ['to_state'] from D-S041-001 — verify correctness
entries.s1_description: some implementations may wish to automatically OPEN a connection on the first SEND or RECEIVE issued by the user for a given connection
entries.s2_description: In particular, some implementations may wish to automatically OPEN a connection on the first SEND or RECEIVE issued by the user for a given connection.
entries.s1_trigger: first SEND or RECEIVE issued by user

entries.llm_reason: Both statements describe the same MUST-63 requirement to ignore SYNs with invalid source addresses.
entries.s1_description: An incoming SYN with an invalid source address MUST be ignored either by TCP or by the IP layer (MUST-63).
entries.s2_description: An incoming SYN with an invalid source address MUST be ignored either by TCP or by the IP layer [(MUST-63)] (see Section 3.2.1.3).
